create_gtn_graph: create a GTN graph by adding start and accept nodes with labeled arcs between them
set_graph_weights: set graph arc weights using a Python list, numpy array, or ctypes pointer
compare_gtn_graphs: compare two GTN graphs for equality or isomorphism using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
save_load_gtn_graph: save a GTN graph to disk and load it back using gtn.savetxt or gtn.save
run_autograd_backward: run backward pass on GTN graph operations to compute gradients with gtn.backward
